steps.prompt: Their LD stands at the point on my side. Tap the point.

fb.right: That is the point. Just inside our blue line, near the boards. When they attack, a defender waits there for a pass.
fb.close: Nearly. The point is right inside our blue line, by the boards, where their LD is standing.
fb.wrong: The point is further up, just inside our blue line near the boards. Look for their LD.

fb.right: That is the slot: the ice in front of our net, between the two circles. Most goals come from here.
fb.close: Nearly. The slot is in front of our net, between the two circles.
fb.wrong: The slot is the ice straight in front of our net, between the two faceoff circles.

steps.prompt: Tap my wall at the hash marks.

fb.right: That is my wall, at the hash marks. A winger waits here for the puck when we break out.
fb.close: Nearly. Right on the boards, beside the short lines next to the circle.
fb.wrong: My wall is the right-hand boards. The hash marks are the short lines beside the circle.

steps.prompt: The puck is in our right corner. Tap the strong side, near the faceoff dot.

fb.right: That is the strong side: the half of the rink the puck is in. It moves when the puck moves.
fb.close: Nearly. The strong side is the whole half the puck is in. Tap closer to the dot.
fb.wrong: The strong side is the half of the rink the puck is in. Right now that is the right half.

steps.prompt: Tap a spot above the puck, in the middle of the ice.

fb.right: That is above the puck: further from our net than the puck, so higher on the screen.
fb.close: Nearly. Above the puck means further from our net than the puck is.
fb.wrong: Above the puck is further from our net than the puck, so higher on the screen. Below is closer to our net.

steps.prompt: Tap the spot just inside their LD, between them and our net.

fb.right: That is inside: between an opponent and our net. From here a pass to their LD has to go through you.
fb.close: Nearly. Inside is between their LD and our net, close enough to touch them.
fb.wrong: Inside means between their LD and our net, a stick length away from them.

steps.prompt: Tap the lane from the puck to their LD.

fb.right: That is the lane: the straight line a pass from their C to their LD would travel. Standing in it blocks it.
fb.close: Nearly. The lane is the straight line between the puck and their LD.
fb.wrong: The lane is the straight line from the puck to their LD. A pass travels along it.

steps.prompt: Tap our blue line, in the middle of the ice.

fb.right: That is our blue line, the edge of our zone. Getting the puck across it is a breakout.
fb.close: Nearly. The blue line is the thick line nearest the middle of the rink.
fb.wrong: Our blue line is the thick line that marks the edge of our zone.
